title: Annotatio VI open §.I: Two major classes by Authors, Number, and Mode of treating controversies
pass_a_gloss: ANNOTATION VI. On the Classes of Controversies that stand between Evangelicals, at pp. 353–356. J. 1. Quite quickly our Author divides them into TWO major controversies, attending to an almost triple distinction by which those two Classes are discriminated from each other — namely of Authors, of Number, and of the Mode of treating Controversies.
pass_b_english: ANNOTATION VI. On the classes of controversies that stand between Evangelicals (pp. 353–356).
§. I. Our author quickly splits them into two major classes, marked off by a nearly threefold difference: authors, number, and the mode of handling the disputes.
source_text:
ANNOTATIO VI.
De Controversiarum, quae Evangelicis intercedunt, Classibus ad p.353.356.
J. 1.
Citè admodum Autor noster in DUAS majores controversias dirimit, attendendo discrimen fere triplex, quô Classes istae duae inter se discriminantur, scilicet Autorum, Numeri, & Modi Controversias tractandi.
notes: Annotatio VI open; DUAS classes; Autorum/Numeri/Modi.
